notes.scope: All first attempts retained, including invalid rows and one hosted timeout. Continuation processed only previously unattempted batches.
notes.individual_validity: Schema validity only, not semantic correctness. Atomic batch acceptance is stricter and remains the operational measure.
notes.confidence: Common 0.8 cutoff is uncalibrated; values not known to be interchangeable.
notes.jev_cost: List-price estimate using recorded input tokens at $0.042/M; actual billed cost unavailable, promotions may differ.
notes.hosted_cost: API-reported costs in primary metrics; list-price estimate excludes requests without usage.
